class.name: GameRecorder3D
class.brief_description: A 3D node that records its children's transformations at runtime and exports the captured data to the proprietary Jenova Frame (.jframe) binary format.
class.description:
[GameRecorder3D] is a node that captures a Chadot scene and exports it to third-party DCC tools for cinematic or simulation use cases.
For example, you can create a car in DCC, import it into Chadot, set up car physics, drive it, and let [GameRecorder3D] capture the motion of the simulation. You can then load the captured data back into DCC for car animation. It can also be used for in-engine replay but the importer is [b]not implemented yet[/b].
Currently, [GameRecorder3D] supports capturing all [Node3D] driven nodes, including physics bodies, as well as bones and skeleton animation.

method.name: write_collected_frames
method.description: Writes the collected frames from memory to disk. Use this function only if the game does not quit gracefully.

class.name: JenovaFrameImporter
class.brief_description: An importer that loads the proprietary Jenova Frame (.jframe) binary format sequence and animates the active scene using its data.
class.description: [JenovaFrameImporter] is an engine singleton that imports a Jenova Frame Sequence into the active scene. Any 3D scene in the engine can be exported using [GameRecorder3D]. Can be accessed from [b]Scene > Import... > Import Jenova Frame Sequence...[/b] [b]Note:[/b] Only available in the editor.

method.name: open_import_dialog
method.description: Opens the importer dialog to import frame sequence data.

method.name: import_animation_sequence
method.description: Directly imports a frame sequence from a file using the specified framerate.
